summary: The three cards share one class, team. A second class (games, robots) is a hook the CSS uses to change a variable for that card only.
notes: class="team games" gives the card both classes.
The HTML does not contain any colors. Every color comes from a variable in the CSS.
Adding a fourth team only needs a new class and one variable in the CSS.
pitfall: Writing a style="" attribute on each card to change its color. That spreads design choices across the HTML and makes them hard to update.
